title: audit detail session.context_fallback
description: detail of audit rows with action session.context_fallback: the session continued with a new conversation because its checkpoint could not be restored; reason from the closed list (ADR-059 section 7). Metadata only (02-data-model.md section 2.9); every value is flat (string of printable ASCII up to 256 characters, integer, boolean or null) like the generic detail of api/org-audit.response.json.
